Nina (Growth): Heads up: our webinar sign-up KPI shows a weird spike Thursday 11:30 PST — but the registration form shows normal submissions. dashboard link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/webinar_signup
ops-bot: CDN purge completed for /webinar-assets at 11:15 PST.
Cal (Data): Spike aligns with CDN purge. possible duplicate pixel firing? running a quick dedupe check.
Jasper : Did we change the registration widget on the page? Marta, ops for the event?
Marta (Events): Nope, no widget changes. we did add a promotional image to the page earlier but that shouldn't affect analytics.
Cal (Data): Query: ```sql
SELECT event_id, user_id, created_at, source
FROM signup_events
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-19 17:00:00' AND campaign='q2_webinar'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Cal (Data): Results show many events with unique user_id but duplicate event_id variants (likely from CDN edge replays).
Nina (Growth): Okay so this is instrumentation noise. Can we mark the KPI as adjusted and hide the spike in the weekly readout?
Cal (Data): I'll add an "instrumentation-adjusted" series to the KPI and keep raw series for audit. I'll also add a note in the dashboard footer.
Jasper : Add a follow-up action to check CDN edge caching headers for analytics pixel TTL.
Marta (Events): On it. I'll loop in web infra to tighten caching rules for analytics endpoints.
Nina (Growth): Thanks. Small ask: can we surface both raw vs adjusted on the top-level weekly chart? Product wants to see both.
Cal (Data): Yep. Added both. Updated snapshot run 2063457001.
Nina (Growth): Nice. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
